purpose: Teach: 歯車/一心/下ろす/見下ろす/談義/植生/フラグ/のむ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、家族の、絶対、歯車、絶対、として、絶対、お手伝いしたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to help out with things around the house. I mean it.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, words tumbling out with genuine conviction. Quick pace, no hesitation. The kind of serious that only a child trying very hard can be.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、勉強に、絶対、一心、絶対、に、絶対、取り組んでくれてありがとうね
lines.en: Sho, thank you so much for throwing yourself into your studies like this. I'm really proud of you.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice. A slight catch on the gratitude—she means it deeply. Gentle pace, present and attentive. The certainty of a mother seeing her child clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お買い物の、絶対、荷物、絶対、ぼく、絶対、下ろす、絶対、お手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to help carry in the groceries. Let me do it—I can handle it.
lines.style: Chest lifted slightly, pride in the voice. Direct and capable, as if proving something he already believes about himself. Steady tempo, no apology.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんと、本気で、絶対、屋上から、絶対、町、絶対、見下ろす、絶対、と、絶対、いい景色よ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, when you and Dad look out from the rooftop at the town, the view really is beautiful, isn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Soft, reflective, slightly wistful. A mother noticing a moment her son will remember. Gentle breath before the question. Tempo slows on the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママと、本気で、絶対、絵本、絶対、談義、絶対、しよう
lines.en: I want to look at picture books with you and talk about them, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet intensity underneath. Not loud, but sure. The words come with a kind of shy determination. Slightly faster on 'with you'—eager to include her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、植生、絶対、ママ、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、管理してるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: I keep the garden plants really well-maintained, you know. It takes care and attention.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride woven with gentle instruction. Voice steady and practiced, the tone of someone sharing something she does well. Slight pause before the explanation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくの新作の、本気で、絶対、フラグ、絶対、立ったよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom—something good happened with my new project! A real breakthrough.
lines.style: Sudden bright energy, excitement breaking through. Quick attack on the opening. Voice lifts noticeably. The kind of animated that shows he's been waiting to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お祝いに、絶対、お酒、絶対、のむ、絶対、らしいわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Apparently your father's going to celebrate with sake, it sounds like. Isn't that nice, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, indulgent, with a touch of affectionate amusement at the father's predictability. Calm tempo. The gentle observation of someone comfortable in her role, watching her family.
